title: The Control-Flow Tax: Specialized Decision Routing for LLM Agent Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2611.32365v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An agent can spend almost as much deciding what to do as doing it. In our documentation workflow, control-flow routing accounts for 42.5% of baseline reference cost on the initial task. Lower token prices alone do not solve this control-flow tax: inexpensive general-purpose routers can trigger additional calls to the expensive generator. We evaluate a heterogeneous architecture in which Jev, a specialized System 1 decision model, controls finite actions while Sol generates documents. Across four software tasks, 480 valid runs comprise 470 completions and ten request-limit endpoints. Jev full routing achieves the lowest mean cost and elapsed time on every task, completing all 40 specialist-controlled runs along the shortest trajectory. On the initial task, mean cost falls by 49.6% (95% paired-bootstrap interval: 42.9% to 56.3%) and elapsed time by 33.2% (19.6% to 46.7%). translated_title: 控制流税：面向大语言模型智能体工作流的专用决策路由
translated_abstract: 智能体在“决定做什么”上花费的开销几乎与“实际执行”相当。在我们的文档工作流中，控制流路由占初始任务基准参考成本的42.5%。仅靠降低token价格并不能解决这一“控制流税”问题：廉价的通用路由器可能会触发对昂贵生成器的额外调用。我们评估了一种异构架构，其中Jev——一个专用的“系统1”决策模型——负责控制有限的动作集合，而Sol负责生成文档。在四项软件任务中，480次有效运行包含470次完成和十次因请求上限而终止的终点。Jev全路由在每个任务上都实现了最低的平均成本与耗时，所有40次由专用模型控制的运行均沿最短轨迹完成。在初始任务上，平均成本下降49.6%（95%配对自助法区间：42.9%至56.3%），耗时下降33.2%（19.6%至46.7%）。在另外三项任务中，成本降幅为40.5%至42.9%……
tldr: 该论文提出一种异构架构，用轻量专用的“系统1”决策模型Jev接管控制流路由、由大模型Sol专注文档生成，从而显著降低LLM智能体工作流中的“控制流税”（成本降低约40%–50%，耗时降低约33%）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a heterogeneous architecture in which a lightweight specialized System-1 decision model (Jev) handles control-flow routing while a large generator (Sol) produces documents, cutting the "control-flow tax" of LLM agent workflows by roughly 40–50% in cost and 33% in elapsed time.
